findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_court_case, subscribe_to_case_updates, estimate_license_points, check_traffic_charge, search_judgments · Private data: lookup_court_case, search_cases_by_party, search_cases_by_attorney, search_cases_by_business, get_attorney_hearing_calendar, estimate_license_points, check_traffic_charge, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments, list_cases_filed · Public sink: lookup_court_case, subscribe_to_case_updates, court_visit_info, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments · Destructive: lookup_court_case, search_cases_by_party, get_attorney_hearing_calendar, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_court_case, subscribe_to_case_updates, estimate_license_points, check_traffic_charge, search_judgments · Private data: lookup_court_case, search_cases_by_party, search_cases_by_attorney, search_cases_by_business, get_attorney_hearing_calendar, estimate_license_points, check_traffic_charge, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments, list_cases_filed · Public sink: lookup_court_case, subscribe_to_case_updates, court_visit_info, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments · Destructive: lookup_court_case, search_cases_by_party, get_attorney_hearing_calendar, screen_names_by_party, search_judgments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
